winter_walk_1.description: this sprite sheet of the same man walking in four directions, now dressed for a city winter: a long camel-brown wool overcoat over his clothes, the collar turned up, a dark charcoal scarf at the neck, black leather gloves; keep exactly the same poses, frames, hair, glasses, face and skin, same pixel-art style, colours and outline weight, transparent background

winter_portrait_1.description: the same man, same face, expression, hair, glasses and skin, now wearing a long camel-brown wool overcoat with the collar turned up and a dark charcoal scarf wrapped at the neck instead of his jacket; same pixel-art style, colours and outline weight
